formula: mu=sum(x_t)/V; sigma=sqrt(sum((x_t-mu)^2)/V); score_g=(mean(x_t for t in g)-mu)/sigma
vocabulary_population: all 262144 IDs, including special and unused IDs, as in S1; no filtering of normalization population
why: Removes positive multiplicative scale and common additive offset, keeps unsaturated relative logit magnitudes. Simpler linear group contrast than rank scoring. It does not guarantee semantic specificity.
ranking: Face validity: descending primary score, then ascending layer and neuron index; include layer0. No percentile-first ranking for this check.
face_bar: For each group: at least 10 of the top20 neurons have at least 3 group member token IDs among their pre-softcap top20. Space-marker variants are separate vocabulary IDs. No tuning after results.
sanity_selection: Retain S1 rule: 6 highest banmal then 6 highest polite excluding selected, order by (layer-control percentile, primary score, lower layer, lower index); same 12 random neurons and seed. Compare the 24 neuron identities with archived S1; rerun only if identities change. Match controls to new layers, keep dose/prompts/API scope unchanged.
controls: Reuse exact S1 control_directions.f32, 512 per layer; no new random control distribution.
post_softcap: reference field only; cannot affect primary score or ranking
